title: Velantrim Answer Trace / Receipt
description: The two provenance artifacts the runtime actually emits: (1) the answer trace — the ordered list of trace items produced by core/trace.py build_trace() and returned in the pipeline result under 'trace'; (2) the sealed, replayable receipt produced by core/provenance.py build_receipt(). Both are verifiable offline without the LLM that phrased the answer. Receipts carry no separate receipt_id/trace_id: a receipt is identified and sealed by its content digest.

trace.description: Answer trace as emitted by core/trace.py build_trace(): one item per retrieved fact used to ground the answer.

source.description: Human-readable origin label of the fact

origin.description: How the fact entered this trace (e.g. retrieval / ingestion / volition)

epistemic_state.description: ESM state of the fact at retrieval time (full list: core/memory.py ESM_STATES)

confidence.description: Retrieval relevance/confidence score for this item

receipt.description: Sealed provenance receipt as emitted by core/provenance.py build_receipt() (RECEIPT_VERSION 2). The digest covers the sealed fields (version, created_at, query, answer, citations); 'signature' is present only when an HMAC key is configured.

version.description: Receipt format version (currently 2: embeds source-span evidence in citations when present)

answer.description: The attested answer. A blocked result (answer null) never produces a receipt.

digest.description: Content digest over the sealed fields; identifies the receipt (there is no separate receipt_id)

signature.description: Optional HMAC signature of the digest (present only when a signing key is configured)

claim_sha256.description: Hash of the cited claim text (content is not embedded in the receipt)

evidence.description: Receipt v2: sealed source-span evidence attached to the cited fact (present only when spans exist)
